proposed_comments.title: Use the platform focused border brush in the normal theme
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the platform focused border brush in the normal theme

**Severity:** `medium`

The light-theme focused parameter border uses `SystemAccentColorLight2`, which can be too pale against `TextControlBackgroundFocused` and make the 2 px focus indication difficult to see. Use `TextControlBorderBrushFocused` so the parameter control follows the theme-adaptive focused TextBox border resource.

**Verification:** Build Microsoft.CmdPal.UI and verify focused parameter borders in light, dark, and high-contrast themes.

confidence.rationale: The hard-coded light accent is visibly weaker than the platform focused-control brush; the corrected resource builds on the exact-head candidate.

proposed_comments.title: Use the platform focused border brush in the colorful theme
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the platform focused border brush in the colorful theme

**Severity:** `medium`

The colorful light-theme dictionary has the same pale `SystemAccentColorLight2` focused border. Use `TextControlBorderBrushFocused` here as well so both parameter styles follow the platform's theme-adaptive focus indication.

**Verification:** Build Microsoft.CmdPal.UI and compare focus visibility in the colorful light theme and high contrast.

confidence.rationale: The duplicated hard-coded resource has the same contrast issue, and the corrected resource builds on the exact-head candidate.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve caret synchronization across unload and reload
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve caret synchronization across unload and reload

**Severity:** `high`

These switchable parameter text boxes enable `TextBoxCaretColor.SyncWithForeground`, but the attached behavior detaches its `Loaded` handler when the control unloads while leaving the attached property enabled. When the parameters view is hidden and shown again, caret synchronization can stop permanently.

Update `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/TextBoxCaretColor.cs` so unload/reload preserves or re-registers the `Loaded` hook and reapplies the caret color. Cover both `StringParamTemplate` and `ListParamTemplate` instances.

**Verification:** Open a parameter editor, hide and reopen the parameters view, and confirm caret and foreground colors remain synchronized.

confidence.rationale: The attached property remains enabled after the behavior removes its own reload hook; the lifecycle correction builds in both validated trees.
